# jsDelivr
> A free, fast, and reliable open-source CDN for npm packages, GitHub repositories, WordPress assets, and static files.

jsDelivr provides globally distributed content delivery for open-source projects, package files, and website assets, along with public APIs, package browsing tools, and documentation for integrating CDN-hosted resources.

## Documentation
- [Documentation Home](https://www.jsdelivr.com/documentation): Overview of jsDelivr features, usage patterns, and integration options.
- [Using jsDelivr](https://www.jsdelivr.com/documentation#id-using-jsdelivr): Core concepts for loading files from npm, GitHub, and WordPress.
- [Combine Multiple Files](https://www.jsdelivr.com/documentation#id-combine-multiple-files): How to request several files in a single combined CDN URL.
- [Load Multiple Versions](https://www.jsdelivr.com/documentation#id-load-multiple-versions): Guidance for serving different package versions through jsDelivr.
- [Purge Cache](https://www.jsdelivr.com/documentation#id-purge-cache): Instructions for clearing cached files from the CDN.
- [Public API](https://www.jsdelivr.com/documentation#id-public-api): Summary of available API endpoints for package and CDN data.
- [ESM Support](https://www.jsdelivr.com/documentation#id-esm-support): Notes on serving JavaScript modules through jsDelivr.
- [WordPress Integration](https://www.jsdelivr.com/documentation#id-wordpress): Details on WordPress plugin and theme asset delivery.

## Package Endpoints
- [npm Package CDN](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/): Base endpoint for serving files from npm packages.
- [GitHub Repository CDN](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/): Base endpoint for serving files from GitHub repositories.
- [WordPress Assets CDN](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/wp/): Base endpoint for serving WordPress plugins and themes.
- [Combined Files Endpoint](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/combine/): Endpoint for concatenating multiple files into one request.
- [Static Files CDN](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/): Root CDN endpoint for jsDelivr-hosted content.
- [Package Browser](https://www.jsdelivr.com/package): Search and browse packages available through jsDelivr.

## Public API
- [API Root](https://data.jsdelivr.com/v1/): Base URL for jsDelivr public metadata APIs.
- [List npm Package Versions](https://data.jsdelivr.com/v1/package/npm/jquery): Returns metadata and available versions for an npm package.
- [List GitHub Package Versions](https://data.jsdelivr.com/v1/package/gh/jquery/jquery): Returns metadata and available versions for a GitHub repository.
- [npm Package Flat File List](https://data.jsdelivr.com/v1/package/npm/jquery@3.7.1/flat): Returns a flattened file listing for a package version.
- [GitHub Package Flat File List](https://data.jsdelivr.com/v1/package/gh/jquery/jquery@3.7.1/flat): Returns a flattened file listing for a repository tag.
- [npm Package Entry Metadata](https://data.jsdelivr.com/v1/package/npm/jquery@3.7.1): Returns package metadata for a specific npm version.
- [GitHub Entry Metadata](https://data.jsdelivr.com/v1/package/gh/jquery/jquery@3.7.1): Returns repository metadata for a specific tag.
- [Network Stats API](https://data.jsdelivr.com/v1/stats/network): Returns CDN-wide network statistics and usage data.

## Package Tools
- [Package Search](https://www.jsdelivr.com/package): Search for npm, GitHub, and WordPress packages on jsDelivr.
- [npm Package View](https://www.jsdelivr.com/package/npm/jquery): Browse package metadata, versions, and files for an npm package.
- [GitHub Package View](https://www.jsdelivr.com/package/gh/jquery/jquery): Browse repository metadata, tags, and files for a GitHub package.
- [WordPress Plugin View](https://www.jsdelivr.com/package/wp/woocommerce): Browse metadata and files for a WordPress plugin.
- [WordPress Theme View](https://www.jsdelivr.com/package/wp/twentytwentyone): Browse metadata and files for a WordPress theme.
- [Package Statistics](https://www.jsdelivr.com/package/npm/jquery): View usage and version information for a package.

## Open Source Projects
- [Public GitHub Organization](https://github.com/jsdelivr): Source repositories for jsDelivr services, tools, and infrastructure.
- [Website Repository](https://github.com/jsdelivr/www.jsdelivr.com): Source code for the jsDelivr website.
- [Data API Repository](https://github.com/jsdelivr/data.jsdelivr.com): Source code for the public metadata API service.
- [Package Browser Repository](https://github.com/jsdelivr/package-finder): Source code for jsDelivr package discovery tools.
- [Purge Service Repository](https://github.com/jsdelivr/purge.jsdelivr.net): Source code for cache purge functionality.
- [ESM Service Repository](https://github.com/jsdelivr/es-module-shims): Related open-source tooling used with modern module delivery.

## Status and Operations
- [Status Page](https://status.jsdelivr.com/): Service health, incidents, and operational status for jsDelivr systems.
- [Global Network Map](https://www.jsdelivr.com/network): Overview of jsDelivr’s global CDN infrastructure and providers.
- [Purge Tool](https://www.jsdelivr.com/tools/purge): Web interface for purging cached files from the CDN.
- [DNS Checker Tool](https://www.jsdelivr.com/tools/dns): Tool for checking DNS resolution related to jsDelivr services.
- [Converter Tool](https://www.jsdelivr.com/tools/convert): Tool for converting GitHub, npm, and WordPress URLs to jsDelivr links.
